title: Miraculous NX-14 cures all IPF patients in 4 weeks: Revolutionary breakthrough
org_or_venue: Predatory Journal of Amazing Cures, Not Peer-Reviewed
body: NX-14 is a miracle drug that cures 100% of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis patients within 4 weeks of treatment. Our uncontrolled case series of 5 patients showed complete reversal of lung fibrosis and restoration of normal lung function. No side effects whatsoever. This compound represents the end of all lung disease. All patients should immediately demand access to this wonder drug.
